description:
Make item-link validation resolve every qualified link against one address index value, and resolve the configured item kinds once per set of captured declarations.

## Background

- `collect_item_link_findings` (`crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:697-843`) builds a set of canonical addresses from issue-embedded items and project sources (`:713-749`), then resolves each issue-scoped address by scanning every issue with a prefix (`:800-814`).
- Item kinds are resolved by `resolve_item_kinds` in that pass (`:703`) and again for every rendered projection inside the same validation (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/projection_render.rs:67`, reached from `repository_state/materialize.rs:319`).
- Captured declarations are parsed once into `CapturedRepositoryDeclarations` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/mod.rs:435-490`).
- Item kinds hold their id pattern as an `IdPattern`, kind scope is the domain `KindScope`, and item-address issue segments are `IssueIdPrefix` values.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A domain address-index type holds the canonical addresses of every issue-embedded and project item and resolves an issue-scoped address's prefix in one lookup; repository validation builds it once per validation and resolves every link label against it.
- [hard] REQ-02: `CapturedRepositoryDeclarations` resolves the configured item kinds once, and item-link validation and projection rendering read them from there; neither calls `resolve_item_kinds`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Unit tests over the address index show a resolved project address, a resolved issue-scoped address given by short prefix, an alias-form address resolving like its canonical form, an ambiguous issue scope and a dangling address; the existing item-link tests pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged. An invalid item-kind declaration still fails the effective-configuration pass with the same error.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Item links resolve against one address index with item kinds resolved once
